name: load_background_music_sequence

stack.evidence: func_001E9770 passes the top value to func_0011E860 as the music ID, stores the preceding value minus one as the destination slot, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: func_0011E860 formats the music ID as amusic/music%3d.bgm, and func_001E9770 queues that file for asynchronous CD/DVD loading. Its completion chain passes the loaded buffer and zero-based slot to func_0011E9A8, which initializes the background-music sequence in that slot. All five JP calls use slot 1, are followed by command 250's load wait, and occur after the corresponding command 567 wave-bank load.
